facts.text: Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
facts.possibly_moot: Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows about her night visits and is not interested, and she left crestfallen (beat_61, beat_62); Dunk was never released from the promise.

facts.text: Will Ingrid keep making her nightly visits to Warwick, which he blames on Clurichen, now that Sir Phidipaldi has told her Warwick knows and is not interested?
